review_candidates.title: Senior Java Spring Boot Developer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The ideal candidate will have at least 7 years of professional experience in Java backend development, with a deep understanding of designing and building scalable, secure, and high-performance APIs and microservices using the Spring ecosystem. Roles & Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain backend services and REST APIs using Java and Spring Boot. Build and maintain a microservices architecture with clear service boundaries and scalability in mind. Write clean, maintainable, and well-do
eligibility_evidence: About Us Omnix International is a Sharia’a compliant company with 35+years of presence in the market.
Since late 2018, Omnix International is fully owned by Al-Imtiaz Group which is a publicly listed company in Kuwait Stock Exchange.
Today, Omnix International employs over 1,500 professionals with offices in Dubai (HQ), Kuwait, Abu Dhabi, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Oman .
In addition, Omnix International offers part of its technical services towards applications development and quality assurance through the Omnix International competency center in Egypt.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Job Description We are looking for a highly skilled Java Developer with strong hands-on experience in Spring Boot to join our development team. The ideal candidate will have at least 7 years of professional experience in Java backend development, with a deep understanding of designing and building scalable, secure, and high-performance APIs and microservices using the Spring ecosystem. Requirements Qualification and Education Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Minimum Experience/Skills Required: 7+ years of hands-on experience in Java development. Solid expertise in Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, and Spring Security. Proficient in building RESTful APIs and integrating with external services.
